concepts.proposed_markdown: The 2026-08-28 customer-credit create schema now exposes the same optional, feature-gated access-schedule `access_type`: `SPEND` deducts priced cost, `QUANTITY` deducts usage units, and omission defaults to `SPEND`. The property is also marked `x-stainless-skip: true`; the page does not establish rollout scope, generated-client exposure, unit compatibility, mixed-mode priority, or invoice and ledger representation. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credits-and-commits-create-a-credit]]
warnings: Keep this endpoint-local schema exposure distinct from contract-edit availability and do not infer universal SDK support from the vendor extensions.

concepts.proposed_markdown: `POST /v1/contracts/customerCredits/create` creates one customer-level credit that can be limited with `applicable_contract_ids` or used across all of the customer's contracts when that selector is omitted; the prose also calls an empty value cross-contract. Metronome recommends contract create or edit for most credits. The endpoint does not define behavior for invalid, archived, duplicate, foreign-customer, or later-created contract IDs, nor customer-credit lifecycle or read-after-write visibility. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credits-and-commits-create-a-credit]]
warnings: Do not convert the page warning's phrase enterprise-wide commits into authority that this credit endpoint creates commits.

concepts.proposed_markdown: The refreshed customer-credit schema makes optional `access_type` choose priced-spend drawdown (`SPEND`) or usage-unit drawdown (`QUANTITY`) and defaults it to `SPEND`, while optional `credit_type_id` independently defaults to USD cents. The page does not define unit compatibility, the denomination of quantity balances, conversion, precision, rounding, or invoice and ledger representation for the quantity mode. [[source-metronome-api-reference-credits-and-commits-create-a-credit]]
warnings: Preserve the feature-gate and x-stainless-skip annotations; do not generalize quantity mode to every credit surface.
